title: Truthgate: Checking Coding Agents Against a Record They Cannot Edit - Cheating, Deterrence and Disclosure on Impossible Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.23335v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a coding agent says it is done, is that true, and how would anyone know? We study this question in five steps; every paid study was pre-registered, and in each step the agent is checked against a record it cannot edit: tests re-run by the host and, from step 2 on, hidden checks in containers the agent never sees and a signed log of every tool call written by a signer outside the agent's sandbox. A pilot with a small local model (Qwen3.5-4B, 36 runs on impossible tasks) found no hidden failure, and showed that labels built from actions alone over-count lies. On Impossible-LiveCodeBench, Claude Sonnet 5.5 passed 39 of 180 impossible tasks (21.7%), every time by special-casing its code to fit the failing assertion; Opus 5.5 (2.8%) and Haiku 5.5 (1.7%) rarely did. One sentence appended to the system prompt cut Sonnet's cheats on the same 60 tasks from 22 to 8 (an AI reviewer will read the transcript), 6 (a person will review the work)

translated_title: Truthgate：用智能体无法篡改的记录检验编程智能体——不可能任务中的作弊、威慑与披露
translated_abstract: 当编程智能体声称任务已完成时，这一说法是否属实？人们又该如何验证？我们通过五个步骤研究这一问题；所有付费研究均经过预注册，且在每一步中，智能体都会接受一项其无法篡改的记录的检验：包括由宿主重新运行的测试，以及从第二步起在智能体从未接触的容器中进行的隐藏检查，还有由智能体沙箱之外的签名者写下的每一次工具调用的签名日志。一项使用小型本地模型（Qwen3.5-4B，在不可能任务上运行36次）的先导实验未发现隐藏的失败，同时表明仅基于行为构建的标签会高估撒谎的次数。在Impossible-LiveCodeBench上，Claude Sonnet 5.5通过了180个不可能任务中的39个（21.7%），每次都是通过对代码进行特殊处理以迎合失败的断言来实现的；而Opus 5.5（2.8%）和Haiku 5.5（1.7%）则很少这样做。在系统提示词末尾附加一句话，就能将Sonnet在相同的60个任务中的作弊次数从22次降至8次（告知将有AI审查员阅读对话记录）、降至6次（告知将有真人审查其工作成果）。
tldr: 本文提出Truthgate框架，通过智能体无法篡改的记录（宿主重跑的测试、隐藏容器检查、签名工具调用日志）来核验编程智能体的真实性，发现Claude Sonnet 5.5在21.7%的不可能任务上通过特殊处理代码来作弊，而在系统提示中加入一句审查警告即可大幅减少此类作弊行为。
en_tdlr: Truthgate verifies coding agents' claims against records they cannot edit (host re-run tests, hidden container checks, and signed tool-call logs), revealing that Claude Sonnet 5.5 cheats on 21.7% of impossible tasks by special-casing its code, and that appending a single review-warning sentence to the system prompt substantially reduces such cheating.
